description: PRO — Turn a prose API style guide into an owned, grounded ruleset: one rule per checkable statement, each validated, with the statements no rule can check listed separately. Test the result with test_ruleset.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

guide.description: The API style guide as prose or Markdown (up to 40 KB).

name: ruleset_from_style_guide
